saintapediafeedback-desc: Floating feedback widget for article improvement suggestions
saintapediafeedback-hidden: Feedback button hidden. Open Improve this article from the page tools menu, or the tab on the screen edge, to show it again.
saintapediafeedback-panel-subtitle: What can we improve? (select all that apply)
saintapediafeedback-comment-placeholder-: Describe the issue in detail. Include specifics like section names, outdated figures, or suggested corrections.
saintapediafeedback-success-body: Editors will use your suggestion to improve this article.
saintapediafeedback-error-generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
saintapediafeedback-error-ratelimit: You've sent a lot of feedback recently. Please try again tomorrow.
saintapediafeedback-error-nocategory: Please select at least one category.
saintapediafeedback-error-captcha: Please complete the captcha and try again.
saintapediafeedback-error-captcha-unavai: Feedback is temporarily unavailable (captcha not configured). Please try again later.
saintapediafeedback-error-namespace: Feedback is not accepted for this type of page.
saintapediafeedback-special-nofeedback: No feedback submitted for this article yet.
right-saintapediafeedback-viewemail: View the optional contact email left on article feedback
right-saintapediafeedback-export: Download the JSON export of article feedback
saintapediafeedback-lookup-help: Opens the full feedback list for that article (including reviewed/dismissed, or empty).
echo-pref-tooltip-saintapediafeedback: Notifications when readers submit article feedback
saintapediafeedback-access-help: Who can use this dashboard is configured on $1 (one MediaWiki group per line; default is administrators).
saintapediafeedback-work-note-placeholde: What did you change? Internal only — not posted to Talk.
saintapediafeedback-work-note-visibility: Visible to everyone who can open this dashboard (default: administrators). Not posted to Talk.
saintapediafeedback-actioned-hint: Recommended: add a private work note. Actioned items are published to the public resolutions list by default (uncheck to keep private).
saintapediafeedback-make-public: Show on public resolutions list (default on)
saintapediafeedback-resolution-summary-p: Public summary (optional), e.g. Fixed outdated population figure
saintapediafeedback-resolutions-need-pag: Open this page with a page id, e.g. Special:SaintapediaFeedback/resolutions/123.
saintapediafeedback-resolutions-empty: No public resolutions for this article yet.
saintapediafeedback-post-talk-link: Also post a short link on the article Talk page
saintapediafeedback-post-talk-hint: Talk only gets a brief note + link to public resolutions — not your private work note or the original reader comment.
saintapediafeedback-talk-section: Feedback '''#$1''' on $2 was marked as actioned. See $3 for public resolutions on this page.
saintapediafeedback-talk-section-public: Feedback '''#$1''' on $2 was marked as actioned and a public resolution was published. See $3.
saintapediafeedback-talk-edit-summary: Note: feedback #$1 actioned (link to public resolutions)
saintapediafeedback-talk-posted: A short link was added on the Talk page.
saintapediafeedback-talk-failed: Could not update the Talk page (check edit permissions or try again).
